There is no caller allowlist — the gating condition is that the registry itself currently custodies the fren, at `ownerOf` (RedemptionExt.sol:119), which only happens after a redemption moved it there at `custodyTransfer` (RedemptionExt.sol:92). Price is twice the LIVE floor read at `floorPerFren` (RedemptionExt.sol:121), so it moves between the quote and the transaction; the payment is pulled and added to the reserve before the fren moves, at `_pullGrow` (RedemptionExt.sol:124). The value written into the event is the amount actually ADDED to the reserve rather than the amount charged, at `_pullGrow` (RedemptionExt.sol:124).

reachability: Permissionless, reached through the registry stub at `materializeLegacyReserve` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1401). Everything else happens inside the library call, which is handed the reserve position by reference at `ReserveRef` (RedemptionExt.sol:155) and the ledger and collection addresses at `collectionLedger` (RedemptionExt.sol:153). The genesis share of what was deposited is accumulated locally at `genesisPending` (RedemptionExt.sol:158), which is the counter a later crystallisation draws on.

value: ERC20 `transferFrom` pulls the generation token from the payer into the registry (line 167)
reachability: Private; two callers, `_pullGrow` (RedemptionExt.sol:124) and `_pullGrow` (RedemptionExt.sol:139). The pull is a raw transferFrom whose boolean is checked at `transferFrom` (RedemptionExt.sol:167), so a token that returns false reverts rather than silently succeeding; a fee-on-transfer token would still over-report, because the amount requested and not the amount received is what is passed on at `amount` (RedemptionExt.sol:171). The interaction precedes the effect here — tokens are pulled, then deposited, then the counter is raised at `genesisReserveOutstanding` (RedemptionExt.sol:182) — and the pay-for-nothing guard at `added` (RedemptionExt.sol:181) is what makes a deposit that maps to zero liquidity revert instead of keeping the payment. The returned value is the amount ADDED, which the callers use in place of the amount charged.
